response.sql: WITH equipment_averages AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS average_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref HAVING AVG(humepct) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS overall_average FROM equipment_averages), kept AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.average_humidity FROM equipment_averages AS e CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE e.average_humidity > o.overall_average), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS kept_average FROM kept) SELECT k.equipref, k.average_humidity, k.average_humidity - o.overall_average AS difference_from_overall, k.average_humidity - m.kept_average AS difference_from_kept FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m WHERE o.overall_average IS NOT NULL AND m.kept_average IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_kept IS NULL, difference_from_kept DESC LIMIT 10;
